0022600154.text: The Boston Celtics (4-1, 3rd in the East) are on the road for the first time this season, visiting the Orlando Magic (2-3, 9th in the East), who are 0-2 at home. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness), and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain). The Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 113-108 win in Boston on April 12, 2026, and this is the first meeting between the teams in 2026-27.
